integrity: All statements are confined to the stated normalization and ring family; finite computational corroboration is separately distinguished from proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact operator norm holds for all dyadic cyclic rings and arbitrary complex inputs. Sharp coset indicators are exhibited, but the full class of extremizers, nondyadic moduli, and higher output moments are not resolved. Finite checks do not substitute for the infinite-family proof. Bibliographic novelty has residual risk.
title: Parity-sharp fourth moments of the dyadic quadratic graph
